# Code of Conduct

## Our Standards

Everyone interacting with this repository — through issues, discussions, or
any other channel — is expected to act professionally and respectfully.
Examples of unacceptable behavior include:

- Harassment, insults, or derogatory comments directed at any person or group.
- Publishing others' private information without explicit permission.
- Any conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a
  professional setting.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within all repository spaces (issues, pull
requests, comments) and in any other setting where an individual is
representing this project.

## Enforcement

Instances of unacceptable behavior may be reported to Parashell at
odin.glynn@parashell.cloud. All complaints will be reviewed and investigated
and will result in a response deemed necessary and appropriate to the
circumstances. Parashell is obligated to maintain confidentiality with
regard to the reporter of an incident.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to reach Parashell about this
project.
